`Maximize/Minimize/Snap-L/Snap-R` emit `$#Up::Send("{Up}")`, `Send("{Down}")`, etc. — a **bare arrow with no `#`**. Same bug class as your reported three — you likely just didn't test them.

`#{Up}` is a valid SendKeys token (`#` modifier + `{Up}`), so this is a one-character-per-row edit in the catalog.
